english.title: Drive a vehicle without licence / insurance at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Luton Airport without

(A)_[a valid licence to drive that vehicle]_
(B)_[insurance or such a security in respect of third party risks as complied with the requirements of Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
(C)_[a valid licence to drive that vehicle and insurance or such a security in respect of third party risks as complied with the requirements of Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.11 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and place
drove a vehicle at Luton Airport without
a valid licence to drive that vehicle / insurance / such security
in respect of 3rd party risks
as complied with Part VI of the RTA 1988

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence only applies to those parts of the airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
